Begin forwarded message:

> From: Paul Shannon <psha...@systemsbiology.org>
> Date: August 3, 2011 8:00:03 AM PDT
> To: xinwa...@gmail.com
> Cc: cytoscap...@googlegroups.com
> Subject: Re: RCytoscape bug! a graph with only one undirected edge.
>
> Dear Xin,
>
> You are exactly right -- this is my bug. In developing RCytoscape unit tests, I overlooked single edge graphs. I will fix this in the development version of the package (currently 1.3.4) and let you know as soon as it is available.
>
> In the meantime here -- a bit of a hack -- is a work around. It requires that you add a second edge then, once the graph is displayed as a Cytoscape network, you can select that extra edge programmatically and delete it. I have added a few extra commands which you might find convenient.
>
> cy = CytoscapeConnection () # general purpose access to Cytoscape operations (but not window-specific operations)
> window.title = 'single edge bug workaround'
> if (window.title %in% as.character (getWindowList (cy))) # in debugging, I often create the same window over and over again
> deleteWindow (cy, window.title) # this bit of code deletes my previous version of this demo window
> g = new ('graphNEL', edgemode='directed') # for now, all RCy graphs must be directed
> g = graph::addNode("A", g) # add three nodes
> g = graph::addNode("B", g)
> g = graph::addNode("C", g)
> g = graph::addEdge(from="A", to="B", graph=g) # the real edge
> g = graph::addEdge(from="A", to="C", graph=g) # add temporary edge
> cw = new.CytoscapeWindow(window.title, graph = g) # create the window in cytoscape
> displayGraph (cw) # send the graph
> setNodeLabelRule (cw, 'label') # standard node attribute 'label' defaults to node name. tell cy to use that attribute
> redraw (cw)
> layout (cw, 'jgraph-spring')
> selectEdges (cw, 'A (unspecified) C') # without explicit 'edgeType' being assigned, 'unspecified' is the default
> deleteSelectedEdges (cw) # now delete it
>
> Don't forget that all methods are documented at http://rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net
>
> Thanks for the bug report!
>
> - Paul
>
>
>
>> Dear all,
>>
>> I found RCytoscape very useful, but one critical bug is found in
>> version 1.2.1 and 1.3 that when I try to upload a graph with six nodes
>> and only one edge, it failed with the error message:
>>
>>> g <- graph::addNode("B", g)
>>> g <- graph::addNode("C", g)
>>> graph::addEdge()
>> from= graph= to= weights=
>>> g<-graph::addEdge(from="A", to="B", graph=g)
>>> g
>> A graphNEL graph with undirected edges
>> Number of Nodes = 3
>> Number of Edges = 1
>>> cw <- new.CytoscapeWindow("test", graph = g)
>>> displayGraph(cw)
>> entering RCytoscape::displayGraph
>> sending 3 nodes
>> sending 1 edges
>> Error in convertToR(xmlParse(node, asText = TRUE)) :
>> faultCode: 0 faultString: No method matching arguments:
>> java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String,
>> java.lang.String, java.lang.Boolean, java.lang.Boolean
>>
>>
>>
>> Any idea for the error?
>>
>> Thanks,

>> Xin
